releaseNotes:
Merlin TV v2.0.0: Complete Architectural & Performance Overhaul.
- Upgraded to MVVM Architecture with Hilt Dependency Injection
- Persistent Room Database for Favorites & Recently Watched History
- Modular & Hardware-Accelerated UI Component Structure
- Bounded 4-Thread Dispatcher for low-latency channel & catalog fetching
- Production Timber Logging and Zero raw stack traces
- Security Hardening with Stream URL Validation & Metadata Sanitization
- Automated GitHub Actions CI/CD Pipeline & Optimized ProGuard/R8 rules
